verdict: APPROVE — all three round-1 FAILs and both FLAGs are closed on paper, member-exact and LOOKED. F1: the roll-aware projection prints every gable deck band foreshortened onto its TRUE plan band — downhill edge 4.5–7 mm INSIDE the eave tip line (was 0.53 m past), uphill edge 5–8 mm short of the ridge on its own side (was 1.06 m of overlap), hip strips never past the arris lines (worst 0.0000 m past-hip, ≥3.9 mm inside the eave, both hips) — and the deck joins the subfloor convention (layer ZERO, fill-opacity 0.35, hairline seam; wrb not drawn): the hip 10×8 sheet is a textbook hip diagram again with ridge/commons/jacks crisp OVER the wash (round-1's opaque patchwork exhibit re-shot and dead), rafters/purlins/valleys read through the deck on all eight scenes. F1b: foundation, wall-framing, electrical AND plumbing/MEP sheets are byte-EQUAL pin vs base on ALL EIGHT scenes — the 16.1 px shared-transform drift is gone, and the flush drip reposition (eave drip outer edge == finish-fascia outer face at 0.0000 m, rake drip == barge face, flat gravel stop inside the rim faces) even retired the demo's honest 0.2 px growth. F2: the deck labels state the EXACT per-compose coverage (hip 10×8 '91.5%', hip 5×4 '84.4%' — both match my independent drawn/plane recomputation to the rounding digit; 'slight under-tile' prose is dead), the printed buy row carries 'tapered planes conservatively under-tiled … buy waste factor separately' on the schedules sheet, and the gate floor is DERIVED from the strip arithmetic across a 4-geometry matrix including the round-1 84.4% counter-example. F3: the valley trim statement is a member FLAG now and PRINTS — takeoff 'FLAG — 4 ea' row + verbatim red line in the schedules flag block ('trim to the valley line on site (overlay framing)'), major deck stays clean. F4: shed no-drip and gambrel rake-metal gaps print as flags the same way. F5: the section cuts rolled plates as thin bands rotated by the TRUE roll hugging the rafter tops eave→ridge (±40/±60/±30, gambrel both plane angles) — the 8.1 m false horizontal chord is gone on every sloped scene while the flat demo keeps its honest level band; the widest surviving unrotated dark rects are slab/footing cuts. FOCUS-6: the three SIZELESS_LEGEND roof rows print on every roof sheet, the 13-row cap holds at the compose's 12 rows with all sized roles kept, and zero roof rows leak onto any other sheet. Census diff is exactly +deck/+wrb/+drip per scene, warnings byte-identical, takeoff diff is add-only (wall rows untouched in BOTH system-filter directions). Suite 1312/0 + tsc clean at the pin.

F1-roof-plan-truth-and-legibility.evidence: Member-exact SVG measurement (scale recovered off the ridge member, 50.39 px/m == exact 1:75): gable40 deck bands — uphill edge +0.005/+0.007 m short of the ridge (no overlap), downhill edge 3.523/3.525 m vs eave tip 3.5298 (spill −6.4/−4.5 mm, i.e. INSIDE); gable60 the same class (−5.0/−7.0 mm). Hip strips (42 on 10×8, 22 on 5×4, incl. the rotated cross-family): worst corner 0.0000 m past the hip lines, ≥3.9 mm inside the eave rect. LOOKED at all eight roof plans: deck prints as a pale translucent wash with hairline seams; rafters, ridge, hips, jacks, purlin rows, outlooker ladders and valley 2x8s all read ON TOP (layer-0 draw order also proven in the SVG: last deck rect precedes the first #444 structural stroke on every sheet). Round-1 exhibit re-shot: crop-hip-r2 vs round-1 crop-hip-pin — the opaque tan patchwork with buried ridge/jacks is now a crisp hip diagram; the honest strip-step notches along the arris lines read as conservative trimming, not noise.
F1-roof-plan-truth-and-legibility.note: The stepped white notches at hips/arrises are the under-tile made visible — honest and legible at print scale.

F1b-shared-transform-byte-stability.evidence: Per-sheet byte-compare pin vs base on all EIGHT scenes: 02-foundation, 03-wall-framing, 05-electrical and 06-plumbing-hvac are byte-EQUAL everywhere (the wall plan equality also pins the A-A cut mark in place). Round-1 measured a uniform 16.1 px drift on the compose and 0.2 px on the demo — both are ZERO now: the planBounds roll projection plus the flush drip edges (eave drip outer edge == finish fascia outer face, gap +0.0000/−0.0000 m re-derived on gable40/60; rake drip outer == barge outer face 5.119 == 5.119 m; flat gravel stop pulled inside the rim faces) mean the roof package adds NO plan envelope at all. Only cover/roof/elevations/section/schedules differ, each by exactly the new content.
F1b-shared-transform-byte-stability.note: Demo graph re-fetched over HTTP and verified byte-identical to the round-1 snapshot before comparing.

F2-under-tile-honesty.evidence: Independent recomputation of drawn strip area / true plane area: hip10x8 91.55% → every deck label prints 'strip-tiled: conservative under-tile, 91.5% of plane area; trim to hip lines on site'; hip5x4 84.39% → '84.4%' (the round-1 exhibit, no longer hiding under a 85% magic floor or 'slight' prose). The test floor is now DERIVED (edge wedges + vanishing tail strips + apex losses) and sweeps [10,8,40], [5,4,30], [16,10,25], [6,6,60] with the label pct pinned to the computed ratio. Underlayment books deck × 1.1 exactly on all six roofed scenes (261.7→287.8 etc.) with the lap factor stated.

Defensible since a multi-roof scene has per-roof ratios one row can't carry, and the printed caveat is complete without the number; if a future round wants the digit on paper, print it per-roof when the scene has one tapered roof.
